main.usage:
Usage: xray-script-personal-use-only.sh [options]
  (no args)          interactive management menu
  --vision | --xhttp | --fallback   one-click quick install of the protocol
  --health | --net-status | --bbr | --net-tune | --nofile-limit   read-only check/tune (cron-safe)
  --export-config | --import-config   config backup & migration (scriptable)
  --subscription   generate subscription config
  --help, -h   show this help

uninstall.title: Uninstall
uninstall.info1: Remove Xray core and project traces (Nginx/acme.sh/certs/Docker kept)
uninstall.info2: Remove only the project-built Nginx (refuses distro builds to protect other sites)

full_installation.title: Installation Flow
full_installation.info1: Stable version, Vision+Reality, block bt, cn, ads, enable geodata auto-update

xray_version.title: Xray Version
xray_version.info3: Custom versions may have config compatibility issues

protocol_config.title: Protocol Config
protocol_config.info1: mKCP sacrifices bandwidth to reduce latency.
protocol_config.info2: XTLS(Vision) solves TLS in TLS issue
protocol_config.info3_1: XHTTP has multiplexing by default, lower latency than Vision
protocol_config.info3_2: v2rayN&G clients have global mux.cool settings, disable before using XHTTP
protocol_config.info3_3: Under current DPI, prefer XHTTP and move the listening port off 443 (e.g. 8443): 443 is the primary probing target; keep 443 when it is a CDN origin
protocol_config.info5: Use VLESS+Vision+REALITY fallback to VLESS+XHTTP on port 443
protocol_config.info6: SNI-based split through Nginx on port 443, supports CDN and direct connection

ca_vendor.title: CA Vendor
ca_vendor.info1: The script defaults to ZeroSSL as the CA server, which may sometimes cause certificate issuance to stay at: Pending, The CA is processing your order, please just wait.
ca_vendor.info2: Let's Encrypt no longer supports OCSP stapling, but this does not affect REALITY usage

config_management.title: Configuration Management
config_management.info3: Includes Nginx update, domain change, web config
config_management.info4: (Non-SNI) Change Xray listen port and restart service
config_management.info6: Enable/repair BBR, read-only health check, kernel net tuning and nofile limit
config_management.info7: Export config and certificates into a single archive, or restore from one (migration / DR)

route_management.title: Custom Routing
route_management.info1: WARP Proxy is deployed via Docker, Docker will be auto-installed.
route_management.info3: Re-applying WARP account frequently may get IP banned by Cloudflare.
route_management.info4: Clear WARP container log files and reset the container.
route_management.info5: Add IP-based block route to ruleTag block-ip.
route_management.info6: Add domain-based block route to ruleTag block-domain.
route_management.info7: (WARP must be enabled) Add WARP IP route to ruleTag warp-ip.
route_management.info8: (WARP must be enabled) Add WARP domain route to ruleTag warp-domain.

sni_config.title: SNI Configuration
sni_config.option8: Manage custom domains and reverse proxy apps
sni_config.info3: Switching CA updates config and affects subsequent certificate issuance
sni_config.info4: List, add, edit, or delete extra HTTPS reverse proxy sites
sni_config.info5: Remove a domain’s certificate (its HTTPS will break)

custom_sites.title: Custom Site Management
custom_sites.info1: Show index, domain, proxy target, and UDS name
custom_sites.info2: Add an independent certificate and reverse proxy site
custom_sites.info3: Modify the domain or upstream target
custom_sites.info4: Delete site config, certificate, and renew record

backup.title: Backup & Migration
backup.info1: Packages script config, Xray config, Nginx sites and certificates; contains private keys, keep it safe
backup.info2: Auto-backs up the current state before import; rolls back on failure without leaving a half-applied state

bbr.title: BBR & Kernel Network
bbr.info1: Idempotent: changes no file when already active
bbr.info2: Read-only: module, params, persist files, live connections
bbr.info3: Host-wide TCP buffers and queues (asks for confirmation)
bbr.info4: limits.d and systemd limits (asks; affects all users)
